chat.m1: Hi! I want an iOS app that makes discovering recipes easy: <k>Dishcover</k>.
chat.m2: Great! Let's talk needs first, then I'll share the <k>design</k>. Once you approve, I'll <k>build</k> it and ship it to the App Store.

analysis.market: Competitors are ad-heavy and search-driven. Browsing is tiring.
analysis.problem: Users can't decide quickly what to cook.
analysis.solutionText: A visual, clean discovery flow and an AI assistant that suggests recipes.

design.card1: Big food photos make decisions faster.
design.card2: Orange accents, soft corners, little text.

build.card2: A new beta after every sprint.

faq.priceNote: Tell me about your project and I'll send a clear quote.
faq.after: Websites include a content management panel and training, so you can update content yourself.
faq.relax: A monthly maintenance plan keeps updates, security and support on me.

duration.q: How long does a website take?
duration.a: Landing page 1–2 weeks, business website 3–5 weeks. iOS MVP 6–12 weeks.

selfEdit.q: Can I update the content myself?
selfEdit.a: Yes. I set up a panel and we go through it together at handover.

maintenance.a: Security updates, bug fixes, small content changes and priority support.

payment.a: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. Larger projects are split into milestones.
